content: Fortune-style Go CLIs use filepath.Walk to find quote files, parse %-delimited or JSON format, pick random index. go-wordwrap (mitchellh) wraps at word boundaries up to target width, never adds trailing spaces. lipgloss.TerminalSize() or term.GetSize(os.Stdout.Fd()) gets terminal width; fallback to 80 columns. Word wrap must happen BEFORE ANSI escape injection or use lipgloss.Wrap() which handles ANSI properly.
